title.en: Everything together: Present Simple, questions, can, time
title.ru: Всё вместе: Present Simple, вопросы, can, время

rule.en: You can now talk about your life: routines in the Present Simple (I work, she works); negatives and questions with don't/doesn't and do/does; what you like and how often (I always drink tea); what you can and can't do; and time (at 7, on Monday, in the morning). Great job — you are ready for the A2 course!
rule.ru: Теперь ты можешь рассказать о своей жизни: распорядок в Present Simple (I work, she works); отрицания и вопросы с don't/doesn't и do/does; что нравится и как часто (I always drink tea); что умеешь и не умеешь; и время (at 7, on Monday, in the morning). Отлично — ты готов к курсу A2!

examples.en: I usually get up at seven and go to work at eight.
examples.ru: Обычно я встаю в семь и иду на работу в восемь.

label.en: Ask and say what you can do

patterns.formula: Can you…? / I can … but I can't …

examples.en: Can you cook? I can cook, but I can't drive.
examples.ru: Ты умеешь готовить? Я умею готовить, но не умею водить.

pitfalls.en: he/she/it → verb-s; after don't/doesn't/can use the base verb.
pitfalls.ru: he/she/it → глагол-s; после don't/doesn't/can — базовый глагол.

pitfalls.en: at + time, on + day, in + part of the day.
pitfalls.ru: at + время, on + день, in + часть дня.

blocks.en: Hello again! I am Ann. I usually get up at seven and go to work at eight. I work in an office.
blocks.ru: И снова привет! Я Анна. Обычно я встаю в семь и иду на работу в восемь. Я работаю в офисе.

blocks.en: I really like my job. In my free time I read and I sometimes play football. I can swim, but I can't drive.
blocks.ru: Мне очень нравится моя работа. В свободное время я читаю и иногда играю в футбол. Я умею плавать, но не умею водить.

blocks.en: At the weekend I don't work. Now I speak a little English, and I am ready for the next lesson — A2!
blocks.ru: На выходных я не работаю. Теперь я немного говорю по-английски и готова к следующему уроку — A2!

dialogue: I work in an office. I really like my job.
Я работаю в офисе. Мне очень нравится работа.
What do you do in your free time?
I read, and I sometimes play football.
Я читаю и иногда играю в футбол.
No, I can't. But I can swim!

instruction.en: Put the verb in the Present Simple.

exercises.prompt: I have no car. I ___ drive.

instruction.en: Put the adverb in the right place.
Choose the correct preposition of time.

exercises.prompt: Я умею плавать, но не умею водить.
answers: I can swim, but I can't drive.
I can swim but I can't drive.

match: i can swim but i can't to drive

explanation.en: can/can't + base verb: I can swim, but I can't drive.
explanation.ru: can/can't + базовый глагол: I can swim, but I can't drive.

explanation.en: What + do + you + do: What do you do?
explanation.ru: What + do + you + do: What do you do?
